<summary><b>View Baseline SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
WITH date_range AS (
    SELECT 
        DATEADD(day, -29, '2022-02-06'::DATE)::DATE AS "start_date",
        '2022-02-06'::DATE AS "end_date"
),
-- Get daily sales data from customer shipments (only table with ORDER_DATE)
daily_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        p."ORDER_DATE"::DATE AS "report_date",
        p."MANUFACTURER",
        SUM(p."NET_SALES") AS "total_net_sales",
        COUNT(DISTINCT p."INVOICE_ID") AS "total_orders",
        COUNT(*) AS "total_shipments"
    FROM "AMAZON_VENDOR_ANALYTICS__SAMPLE_DATASET"."PUBLIC"."PAYMENTS_CUSTOMER_SHIPMENT_DETAILS" p
    WHERE p."ORDER_DATE"::DATE BETWEEN (SELECT "start_date" FROM date_range) 
                                   AND (SELECT "end_date" FROM date_range)
    GROUP BY p."ORDER_DATE"::DATE, p."MANUFACTURER"
),
-- Get inventory snapshot data for manufacturing
inventory_data AS (
    SELECT 
        i."DISTRIBUTOR_VIEW",
        i."PRODUCT_TITLE",
        AVG(COALESCE(i."PROCURABLE_PRODUCT_OOS", 0)) AS "avg_procurable_product_oos",
        SUM(COALESCE(i."SELLABLE_ON_HAND_UNITS", 0)) AS "total_on_hand_units",
        SUM(COALESCE(i."AGED_90PLUS_DAYS_SELLABLE_UNITS", 0)) AS "aged_90plus_units",
        AVG(COALESCE(i."OVERALL_VENDOR_LEAD_TIME_DAYS", 0)) AS "avg_vendor_lead_time"
    FROM "AMAZON_VENDOR_ANALYTICS__SAMPLE_DATASET"."PUBLIC"."RETAIL_ANALYTICS_INVENTORY" i
    WHERE i."DISTRIBUTOR_VIEW" = 'Manufacturing'
    GROUP BY i."DISTRIBUTOR_VIEW", i."PRODUCT_TITLE"
),
-- Get distributor receipts for manufacturing
distributor_receipts AS (
    SELECT 
        d."RECEIVE_DATE"::DATE AS "receive_date",
        d."MANUFACTURER",
        COUNT(*) AS "received_shipments"
    FROM "AMAZON_VENDOR_ANALYTICS__SAMPLE_DATASET"."PUBLIC"."PAYMENTS_DISTRIBUTOR_SHIPMENT_DETAILS" d
    WHERE d."RECEIVE_DATE"::DATE BETWEEN (SELECT "start_date" FROM date_range) 
                                     AND (SELECT "end_date" FROM date_range)
    GROUP BY d."RECEIVE_DATE"::DATE, d."MANUFACTURER"
),
-- Get product catalog for manufacturing
product_catalog AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        pc."DISTRIBUTOR_VIEW",
        pc."MANUFACTURING_CODE",
        pc."BRAND_CODE",
        pc."REPLENISHMENT_CODE"
    FROM "AMAZON_VENDOR_ANALYTICS__SAMPLE_DATASET"."PUBLIC"."PRODUCT_CATALOG" pc
    WHERE pc."DISTRIBUTOR_VIEW" = 'Manufacturing'
)
SELECT 
    ds."report_date",
    ds."MANUFACTURER",
    COALESCE(pc."MANUFACTURING_CODE", 'Unknown') AS "manufacturing_code",
    COALESCE(pc."BRAND_CODE", 'Unknown') AS "brand_code",
    COALESCE(pc."REPLENISHMENT_CODE", 'Unknown') AS "replenishment_code",
    ROUND(COALESCE(ds."total_net_sales", 0), 4) AS "total_net_sales",
    COALESCE(ds."total_orders", 0) AS "total_orders",
    COALESCE(ds."total_shipments", 0) AS "total_shipments",
    COALESCE(dr."received_shipments", 0) AS "received_shipments",
    COALESCE(inv."total_on_hand_units", 0) AS "total_on_hand_units",
    COALESCE(inv."aged_90plus_units", 0) AS "aged_90plus_units",
    ROUND(COALESCE(inv."avg_procurable_product_oos", 0), 4) AS "avg_procurable_product_oos",
    ROUND(COALESCE(inv."avg_vendor_lead_time", 0), 4) AS "avg_vendor_lead_time",
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(ds."total_orders", 0) > 0 
        THEN ROUND(COALESCE(ds."total_net_sales", 0) / ds."total_orders", 4)
        ELSE 0 
    END AS "avg_order_value"
FROM daily_sales ds
LEFT JOIN distributor_receipts dr 
    ON ds."report_date" = dr."receive_date" 
    AND ds."MANUFACTURER" = dr."MANUFACTURER"
LEFT JOIN product_catalog pc 
    ON ds."MANUFACTURER" = pc."MANUFACTURING_CODE"
LEFT JOIN inventory_data inv 
    ON pc."DISTRIBUTOR_VIEW" = inv."DISTRIBUTOR_VIEW"
WHERE ds."MANUFACTURER" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ds."report_date" DESC, ds."MANUFACTURER";
```
</details>

<details>
<summary><b>View SlayQL SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
-- Daily Detailed Sales Report for 'Manufacturing' Distributor View
-- 30 days leading up to February 6, 2022 (Jan 7, 2022 – Feb 6, 2022)

WITH
-- Aggregate sales data at daily product level
sales_data AS (
    SELECT
        "DATE",
        "ASIN",
        "PROGRAM",
        "PERIOD",
        "PRODUCT_TITLE",
        SUM("ORDERED_UNITS")                                            AS "TOTAL_ORDERED_UNITS",
        SUM("ORDERED_REVENUE")                                          AS "TOTAL_ORDERED_REVENUE",
        SUM("SHIPPED_UNITS")                                            AS "TOTAL_SHIPPED_UNITS",
        SUM("SHIPPED_REVENUE")                                          AS "TOTAL_SHIPPED_REVENUE"
    FROM "AMAZON_VENDOR_ANALYTICS__SAMPLE_DATASET"."PUBLIC"."RETAIL_ANALYTICS_SALES"
    WHERE "DISTRIBUTOR_VIEW" = 'Manufacturing'
      AND "PERIOD" = 'DAILY'
      AND "DATE" >= '2022-01-07'
      AND "DATE" <= '2022-02-06'
    GROUP BY "DATE", "ASIN", "PROGRAM", "PERIOD", "PRODUCT_TITLE"
),

-- Aggregate traffic data at daily product level
traffic_data AS (
    SELECT
        "DATE",
        "ASIN",
        "PROGRAM",
        "PERIOD",
        SUM("GLANCE_VIEWS")                                             AS "TOTAL_GLANCE_VIEWS"
    FROM "AMAZON_VENDOR_ANALYTICS__SAMPLE_DATASET"."PUBLIC"."RETAIL_ANALYTICS_TRAFFIC"
    WHERE "DISTRIBUTOR_VIEW" = 'Manufacturing'
      AND "DATE" >= '2022-01-07'
      AND "DATE" <= '2022-02-06'
    GROUP BY "DATE", "ASIN", "PROGRAM", "PERIOD"
),

-- Aggregate inventory data at daily product level
inventory_data AS (
    SELECT
        "DATE",
        "ASIN",
        "PROGRAM",
        "PERIOD",
        AVG("PROCURABLE_PRODUCT_OOS")                                  AS "AVG_PROCURABLE_PRODUCT_OOS",
        SUM("SELLABLE_ON_HAND_UNITS")                                  AS "TOTAL_ON_HAND_UNITS",
        SUM("SELLABLE_ON_HAND_INVENTORY")                              AS "TOTAL_ON_HAND_VALUE",
        SUM("NET_RECEIVED_UNITS")                                      AS "TOTAL_NET_RECEIVED_UNITS",
        SUM("NET_RECEIVED")                                            AS "TOTAL_NET_RECEIVED_VALUE",
        SUM("OPEN_PURCHASE_ORDER_QUANTITY")                            AS "TOTAL_OPEN_PO_QUANTITIES",
        SUM("UNFILLED_CUSTOMER_ORDERED_UNITS")                         AS "TOTAL_UNFILLED_CUSTOMER_ORDERED_UNITS",
        AVG("VENDOR_CONFIRMATION_RATE")                                AS "AVG_VENDOR_CONFIRMATION_RATE",
        AVG("RECEIVE_FILL_RATE")                                       AS "AVG_RECEIVE_FILL_RATE",
        AVG("SELL_THROUGH_RATE")                                       AS "AVG_SELL_THROUGH_RATE",
        AVG("OVERALL_VENDOR_LEAD_TIME_DAYS")                           AS "AVG_VENDOR_LEAD_TIME_DAYS"
    FROM "AMAZON_VENDOR_ANALYTICS__SAMPLE_DATASET"."PUBLIC"."RETAIL_ANALYTICS_INVENTORY"
    WHERE "DISTRIBUTOR_VIEW" = 'Manufacturing'
      AND "DATE" >= '2022-01-07'
      AND "DATE" <= '2022-02-06'
    GROUP BY "DATE", "ASIN", "PROGRAM", "PERIOD"
),

-- Aggregate net PPM data at daily product level
net_ppm_data AS (
    SELECT
        "DATE",
        "ASIN",
        "PROGRAM",
        "PERIOD",
        AVG("NET_PPM")                                                  AS "AVG_NET_PPM"
    FROM "AMAZON_VENDOR_ANALYTICS__SAMPLE_DATASET"."PUBLIC"."RETAIL_ANALYTICS_NET_PPM"
    WHERE "DISTRIBUTOR_VIEW" = 'Manufacturing'
      AND "DATE" >= '2022-01-07'
      AND "DATE" <= '2022-02-06'
    GROUP BY "DATE", "ASIN", "PROGRAM", "PERIOD"
)

-- Main report: join all four datasets on common keys
SELECT
    s."DATE"                                                            AS "REPORT_DATE",
    s."PRODUCT_TITLE"                                                   AS "PRODUCT_TITLE",
    s."ASIN"                                                            AS "ASIN",
    s."PROGRAM"                                                         AS "PROGRAM",
    s."PERIOD"                                                          AS "PERIOD",
    -- Ordered metrics
    s."TOTAL_ORDERED_UNITS"                                             AS "ORDERED_UNITS",
    s."TOTAL_ORDERED_REVENUE"                                           AS "ORDERED_REVENUE",
    ROUND(s."TOTAL_ORDERED_REVENUE" / NULLIF(s."TOTAL_ORDERED_UNITS", 0), 4) 
                                                                        AS "AVG_SELLING_PRICE",
    -- Traffic metrics
    t."TOTAL_GLANCE_VIEWS"                                              AS "GLANCE_VIEWS",
    ROUND(s."TOTAL_ORDERED_UNITS" / NULLIF(t."TOTAL_GLANCE_VIEWS", 0), 4) 
                                                                        AS "CONVERSION_RATE",
    -- Shipped metrics
    s."TOTAL_SHIPPED_UNITS"                                             AS "SHIPPED_UNITS",
    s."TOTAL_SHIPPED_REVENUE"                                           AS "SHIPPED_REVENUE",
    -- Net PPM
    n."AVG_NET_PPM"                                                     AS "AVG_NET_PPM",
    -- Inventory / OOS
    i."AVG_PROCURABLE_PRODUCT_OOS"                                      AS "AVG_PROCURABLE_PRODUCT_OOS",
    i."TOTAL_ON_HAND_UNITS"                                             AS "TOTAL_ON_HAND_UNITS",
    i."TOTAL_ON_HAND_VALUE"                                             AS "TOTAL_ON_HAND_VALUE",
    i."TOTAL_NET_RECEIVED_UNITS"                                        AS "NET_RECEIVED_UNITS",
    i."TOTAL_NET_RECEIVED_VALUE"                                        AS "NET_RECEIVED_VALUE",
    i."TOTAL_OPEN_PO_QUANTITIES"                                        AS "OPEN_PURCHASE_ORDER_QUANTITIES",
    i."TOTAL_UNFILLED_CUSTOMER_ORDERED_UNITS"                           AS "UNFILLED_CUSTOMER_ORDERED_UNITS",
    -- Vendor performance metrics
    i."AVG_VENDOR_CONFIRMATION_RATE"                                    AS "AVG_VENDOR_CONFIRMATION_RATE",
    i."AVG_RECEIVE_FILL_RATE"                                           AS "AVG_RECEIVE_FILL_RATE",
    i."AVG_SELL_THROUGH_RATE"                                           AS "AVG_SELL_THROUGH_RATE",
    i."AVG_VENDOR_LEAD_TIME_DAYS"                                       AS "AVG_VENDOR_LEAD_TIME_DAYS"
FROM sales_data s
LEFT JOIN traffic_data t
    ON  s."DATE"     = t."DATE"
    AND s."ASIN"     = t."ASIN"
    AND s."PROGRAM"  = t."PROGRAM"
    AND s."PERIOD"   = t."PERIOD"
LEFT JOIN inventory_data i
    ON  s."DATE"     = i."DATE"
    AND s."ASIN"     = i."ASIN"
    AND s."PROGRAM"  = i."PROGRAM"
    AND s."PERIOD"   = i."PERIOD"
LEFT JOIN net_ppm_data n
    ON  s."DATE"     = n."DATE"
    AND s."ASIN"     = n."ASIN"
    AND s."PROGRAM"  = n."PROGRAM"
    AND s."PERIOD"   = n."PERIOD"
ORDER BY
    s."DATE",
    s."PRODUCT_TITLE";
```
</details>

<details>

```sql
WITH florida_zip_counts AS (
    -- Count addresses per zip code in Florida
    SELECT 
        "ZIP",
        COUNT(*) AS "ADDRESS_COUNT"
    FROM "US_ADDRESSES__POI"."CYBERSYN"."US_ADDRESSES"
    WHERE "STATE" = 'FL'
    GROUP BY "ZIP"
),
largest_florida_zip AS (
    -- Find the zip code with most addresses
    SELECT 
        "ZIP"
    FROM florida_zip_counts
    ORDER BY "ADDRESS_COUNT" DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
-- Get the northernmost addresses in that zip code
SELECT 
    "NUMBER",
    "STREET",
    "STREET_TYPE",
    "LATITUDE"
FROM "US_ADDRESSES__POI"."CYBERSYN"."US_ADDRESSES"
WHERE "STATE" = 'FL'
    AND "ZIP" = (SELECT "ZIP" FROM largest_florida_zip)
ORDER BY "LATITUDE" DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
</details>

<details>
<summary><b>View SlayQL SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
WITH
  fl_zip_candidates AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "ID_ZIP"
    FROM "US_ADDRESSES__POI"."CYBERSYN"."US_ADDRESSES"
    WHERE "STATE" = 'FL'
  ),
  zip_areas AS (
    SELECT
      g."GEO_ID",
      ST_AREA(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT(gc."VALUE")) AS area
    FROM "US_ADDRESSES__POI"."CYBERSYN"."GEOGRAPHY_INDEX" g
    JOIN "US_ADDRESSES__POI"."CYBERSYN"."GEOGRAPHY_CHARACTERISTICS" gc
      ON g."GEO_ID" = gc."GEO_ID"
    WHERE g."LEVEL" = 'CensusZipCodeTabulationArea'
      AND gc."RELATIONSHIP_TYPE" = 'coordinates_wkt'
      AND g."GEO_ID" IN (SELECT "ID_ZIP" FROM fl_zip_candidates)
  ),
  largest_zip AS (
    SELECT "GEO_ID"
    FROM zip_areas
    ORDER BY area DESC
    LIMIT 1
  )
SELECT
  "NUMBER"          AS address_number,
  "STREET"          AS street_name,
  "STREET_TYPE"     AS street_type
FROM "US_ADDRESSES__POI"."CYBERSYN"."US_ADDRESSES" a
WHERE a."STATE" = 'FL'
  AND a."ID_ZIP" = (SELECT "GEO_ID" FROM largest_zip)
ORDER BY a."LATITUDE" DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
</details>

```sql
WITH road_data AS (
    SELECT 
        "CLASS",
        "SUBCLASS",
        "QUADKEY",
        -- Convert LENGTH_M to numeric, handle potential conversion errors
        TRY_CAST("LENGTH_M" AS FLOAT) AS length_numeric
    FROM "NETHERLANDS_OPEN_MAP_DATA"."NETHERLANDS"."V_ROAD"
    WHERE 
        -- Filter for the specific QUADKEY segments (using LEFT function for exact prefix match)
        (LEFT("QUADKEY", 8) = '12020210' OR LEFT("QUADKEY", 8) = '12020211')
        -- Exclude rows with NULL length values
        AND "LENGTH_M" IS NOT NULL
        -- Ensure conversion to numeric was successful
        AND TRY_CAST("LENGTH_M" AS FLOAT) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    "CLASS",
    "SUBCLASS",
    -- Calculate total road length for Amsterdam (QUADKEY starting with 12020210)
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN LEFT("QUADKEY", 8) = '12020210' THEN length_numeric ELSE 0 END), 4) AS "Amsterdam's road lengths",
    -- Calculate total road length for Rotterdam (QUADKEY starting with 12020211)
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN LEFT("QUADKEY", 8) = '12020211' THEN length_numeric ELSE 0 END), 4) AS "Rotterdam's road lengths"
FROM road_data
GROUP BY "CLASS", "SUBCLASS"
HAVING 
    -- Only include rows where at least one city has non-zero road length
    SUM(CASE WHEN LEFT("QUADKEY", 8) = '12020210' THEN length_numeric ELSE 0 END) > 0
    OR SUM(CASE WHEN LEFT("QUADKEY", 8) = '12020211' THEN length_numeric ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY "CLASS", "SUBCLASS";
```

```sql
WITH city_geometries AS (
    -- Extract Amsterdam and Rotterdam boundary polygons
    SELECT 
        "NAMES":"local"::STRING AS "city_name",
        "GEO_CORDINATES" AS "boundary_geom"
    FROM NETHERLANDS_OPEN_MAP_DATA.NETHERLANDS.V_ADMINISTRATIVE
    WHERE "ADMIN_LEVEL" = '8'
      AND (LOWER("NAMES":"local") LIKE '%amsterdam%' OR LOWER("NAMES":"local") LIKE '%rotterdam%')
),

road_lengths_by_city AS (
    -- For each road in the specified QUADKEY range, determine which city it belongs to
    SELECT 
        r."CLASS",
        r."SUBCLASS",
        cg."city_name",
        r."LENGTH_M"::FLOAT AS "road_length"
    FROM NETHERLANDS_OPEN_MAP_DATA.NETHERLANDS.V_ROAD r
    CROSS JOIN city_geometries cg
    WHERE (r."QUADKEY" LIKE '12020210%' OR r."QUADKEY" LIKE '12020211%')
      AND ST_INTERSECTS(r."GEO_CORDINATES", cg."boundary_geom")
)

-- Aggregate and pivot the data
SELECT 
    rl."CLASS",
    rl."SUBCLASS",
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rl."city_name" = 'Amsterdam' THEN rl."road_length" ELSE 0 END), 4) AS "Amsterdam",
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rl."city_name" = 'Rotterdam' THEN rl."road_length" ELSE 0 END), 4) AS "Rotterdam"
FROM road_lengths_by_city rl
GROUP BY rl."CLASS", rl."SUBCLASS"
ORDER BY rl."CLASS", rl."SUBCLASS";
```

```sql
-- Generate all 24 hours for October 1, 2022 in local time (CDT/CST)
WITH "hours" AS (
    SELECT 
        DATEADD('HOUR', seq, '2022-10-01 00:00:00'::TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS "local_datetime"
    FROM (
        SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY 1) - 1 AS seq
        FROM TABLE(GENERATOR(ROWCOUNT => 24))
    )
),

-- Determine timezone for each hour (CDT before 2:00 AM? Actually on Oct 1, CDT is in effect until first Sunday in Nov)
-- For simplicity, assume CDT for all hours (since Oct 1 is in CDT)
"timezone_per_hour" AS (
    SELECT 
        "local_datetime",
        'CDT' AS "timezone"
    FROM "hours"
),

-- Peak classification based on day of week and hour
"peak_class" AS (
    SELECT 
        "local_datetime",
        "timezone",
        CASE 
            WHEN DAYOFWEEK("local_datetime") IN (1,2,3,4,5) -- Monday to Friday
                 AND HOUR("local_datetime") BETWEEN 7 AND 21 -- 7:00-21:59 (HE 8-22)
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END AS "onpeak",
        CASE 
            WHEN DAYOFWEEK("local_datetime") IN (1,2,3,4,5)
                 AND HOUR("local_datetime") NOT BETWEEN 7 AND 21
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END AS "offpeak",
        CASE 
            WHEN DAYOFWEEK("local_datetime") IN (6,7) -- Saturday or Sunday
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END AS "wepeak",
        CASE 
            WHEN DAYOFWEEK("local_datetime") IN (1,2,3,4,5)
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END AS "wdpeak",
        "local_datetime" AS "marketday"
    FROM "timezone_per_hour"
),

-- Price node info (single row)

        AND "DATATYPEID" = 662
        AND DATE("DATETIME") = '2022-10-01'
),

-- Solar actual (datatypeid 650)
"solar_actual" AS (

    WHERE "OBJECTID" = 10000712973
        AND "DATATYPEID" = 650
        AND DATE("DATETIME") = '2022-10-01'
),

-- Real-time prices (aggregated hourly from RT_PRICES_RECENT_SAMPLE)
"rt_prices" AS (

    FROM "YES_ENERGY__SAMPLE_DATA"."YES_ENERGY_SAMPLE"."RT_PRICES_RECENT_SAMPLE"
    WHERE "OBJECTID" = 10000697078
        AND DATE("DATETIME") = '2022-10-01'

),

-- Day-ahead prices: Not available. Use NULL as placeholder.

),

-- Combine all data (left join to hours)
"combined" AS (
    SELECT 
        h."local_datetime" AS "datetime",
        'CDT' AS "timezone",  -- fixed for Oct 1
        CONVERT_TIMEZONE('America/Chicago', 'UTC', h."local_datetime") AS "datetime_utc",
        pc."onpeak",
        pc."offpeak",
        pc."wepeak",
        pc."wdpeak",
        pc."marketday",
        pn."price_node_name",
        pn."price_node_id",
        NULL AS "dalmp",  -- day-ahead price not available
        rtp."rtlmp",
        lz."load_zone_name",

        lf."load_forecast",

        al."rtload",

        wa."wind_gen",
        sf."solar_gen_forecast",
        sf."solar_gen_forecast_publish_date",
        sa."solar_gen"
    FROM "hours" h
    LEFT JOIN "peak_class" pc ON h."local_datetime" = pc."local_datetime"
    CROSS JOIN "price_node_info" pn
    CROSS JOIN "load_zone_info" lz
    LEFT JOIN "load_forecast" lf ON h."local_datetime" = lf."local_datetime" AND 'CDT' = lf."TIMEZONE"
    LEFT JOIN "actual_load" al ON h."local_datetime" = al."local_datetime" AND 'CDT' = al."TIMEZONE"
    LEFT JOIN "wind_forecast" wf ON h."local_datetime" = wf."local_datetime" AND 'CDT' = wf."TIMEZONE"
    LEFT JOIN "wind_actual" wa ON h."local_datetime" = wa."local_datetime" AND 'CDT' = wa."TIMEZONE"
    LEFT JOIN "solar_forecast" sf ON h."local_datetime" = sf."local_datetime" AND 'CDT' = sf."TIMEZONE"
    LEFT JOIN "solar_actual" sa ON h."local_datetime" = sa."local_datetime" AND 'CDT' = sa."TIMEZONE"
    LEFT JOIN "rt_prices" rtp ON h."local_datetime" = rtp."local_datetime" AND 'CDT' = rtp."TIMEZONE"
)

-- Final report
SELECT 
    'ERCOT' AS "iso",
    "datetime",
    "timezone",
    "datetime_utc",
    "onpeak",
    "offpeak",
    "wepeak",
    "wdpeak",
    "marketday",
    "price_node_name",
    "price_node_id",
    ROUND("dalmp", 4) AS "dalmp",
    ROUND("rtlmp", 4) AS "rtlmp",
    "load_zone_name",
    "load_zone_id",
    ROUND("load_forecast", 4) AS "load_forecast",
    "load_forecast_publish_date",
    ROUND("rtload", 4) AS "rtload",
    ROUND("wind_gen_forecast", 4) AS "wind_gen_forecast",
    "wind_gen_forecast_publish_date",
    ROUND("wind_gen", 4) AS "wind_gen",
    ROUND("solar_gen_forecast", 4) AS "solar_gen_forecast",
    "solar_gen_forecast_publish_date",
    ROUND("solar_gen", 4) AS "solar_gen",
    ROUND(COALESCE("load_forecast",0) - (COALESCE("wind_gen_forecast",0) + COALESCE("solar_gen_forecast",0)), 4) AS "net_load_forecast",
    ROUND(COALESCE("rtload",0) - (COALESCE("wind_gen",0) + COALESCE("solar_gen",0)), 4) AS "net_load_real_time"
FROM "combined"
ORDER BY "datetime";
```

```sql
-- CTE to gather all hourly data components for October 1, 2022
WITH hourly_data AS (
    SELECT 
        pn."datetime" AS "datetime",
        'America/Chicago' AS "timezone",
        CONVERT_TIMEZONE('America/Chicago', 'UTC', pn."datetime") AS "datetime_utc",
        -- Peak classification logic
        CASE 
            WHEN DAYOFWEEK(pn."datetime") IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5) -- Weekdays (Monday=1 through Friday=5)
                 AND HOUR(pn."datetime") BETWEEN 7 AND 21 -- Peak hours 7:00 to 22:00 according to ERCOT
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END AS "onpeak",
        CASE 
            WHEN DAYOFWEEK(pn."datetime") NOT IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
                 OR HOUR(pn."datetime") NOT BETWEEN 7 AND 21
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END AS "offpeak",
        CASE 
            WHEN DAYOFWEEK(pn."datetime") IN (1, 7) -- Saturday and Sunday
                 AND HOUR(pn."datetime") BETWEEN 7 AND 21
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END AS "wepeak",
        CASE 
            WHEN DAYOFWEEK(pn."datetime") IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
                 AND HOUR(pn."datetime") BETWEEN 7 AND 21
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END AS "wdpeak",
        TO_DATE(pn."datetime") AS "marketday",
        pn."price_node_name",
        pn."price_node_id",
        pn."dalmp",
        pn."rtlmp",
        lz."load_zone_name",
        lz."load_zone_id",
        lz."load_forecast",
        lz."load_forecast_publish_date",
        lz."rtload",
        gen."wind_gen_forecast",
        gen."wind_gen_forecast_publish_date",
        gen."wind_gen",
        gen."solar_gen_forecast",
        gen."solar_gen_forecast_publish_date",
        gen."solar_gen",
        -- Net load calculations
        (lz."load_forecast" - COALESCE(gen."wind_gen_forecast", 0) - COALESCE(gen."solar_gen_forecast", 0)) AS "net_load_forecast",
        (lz."rtload" - COALESCE(gen."wind_gen", 0) - COALESCE(gen."solar_gen", 0)) AS "net_load_real_time"
    FROM 
        YES_ENERGY__SAMPLE_DATA.YES_ENERGY_SAMPLE.V_DATA_CATALOG_SAMPLE pn
    -- Join with price node data
    JOIN 
        YES_ENERGY__SAMPLE_DATA.YES_ENERGY_SAMPLE.DATATYPE_SAMPLE dt_pn
        ON dt_pn."INTEGRATION_RULE" = 'DOWN'
    -- Join with load zone data (node ID 10000697078)
    JOIN 
        YES_ENERGY__SAMPLE_DATA.YES_ENERGY_SAMPLE.V_DATA_CATALOG_SAMPLE lz
        ON lz."INTEGRATION_RULE" = 'DOWN'
    -- Join with generation data (object ID 10000712973)
    JOIN 
        YES_ENERGY__SAMPLE_DATA.YES_ENERGY_SAMPLE.V_DATA_CATALOG_SAMPLE gen
        ON gen."INTEGRATION_RULE" = 'DOWN'
    WHERE 
        pn."price_node_id" = 10000697078
        AND TO_DATE(pn."datetime") = '2022-10-01'
)

-- Final report combining all components
SELECT 
    'ERCOT' AS "iso",
    hd."datetime",
    hd."timezone",
    hd."datetime_utc",
    hd."onpeak",
    hd."offpeak",
    hd."wepeak",
    hd."wdpeak",
    hd."marketday",
    hd."price_node_name",
    hd."price_node_id",
    ROUND(hd."dalmp", 4) AS "dalmp",
    ROUND(hd."rtlmp", 4) AS "rtlmp",
    hd."load_zone_name",
    hd."load_zone_id",
    ROUND(hd."load_forecast", 4) AS "load_forecast",
    hd."load_forecast_publish_date",
    ROUND(hd."rtload", 4) AS "rtload",
    ROUND(hd."wind_gen_forecast", 4) AS "wind_gen_forecast",
    hd."wind_gen_forecast_publish_date",
    ROUND(hd."wind_gen", 4) AS "wind_gen",
    ROUND(hd."solar_gen_forecast", 4) AS "solar_gen_forecast",
    hd."solar_gen_forecast_publish_date",
    ROUND(hd."solar_gen", 4) AS "solar_gen",
    ROUND(hd."net_load_forecast", 4) AS "net_load_forecast",
    ROUND(hd."net_load_real_time", 4) AS "net_load_real_time"
FROM 
    hourly_data hd
ORDER BY 
    hd."datetime" ASC;
```

#### 📜 Generated SQL Queries

<details>
<summary><b>View Baseline SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
WITH block_group_data AS (
    SELECT 
        cv."BlockGroupID",
        cv."CensusValue" AS block_group_population,
        dcg."StateCountyTractID",
        dcg."StateAbbrev",
        SUM(cv."CensusValue") OVER (PARTITION BY dcg."StateCountyTractID") AS tract_population
    FROM "CENSUS_GALAXY__ZIP_CODE_TO_BLOCK_GROUP_SAMPLE"."PUBLIC"."Fact_CensusValues_ACS2021" cv
    INNER JOIN "CENSUS_GALAXY__ZIP_CODE_TO_BLOCK_GROUP_SAMPLE"."PUBLIC"."Dim_CensusGeography" dcg
        ON cv."BlockGroupID" = dcg."BlockGroupID"
    WHERE cv."MetricID" = 'B01003_001E'
        AND dcg."StateAbbrev" = 'NY'
)
SELECT 
    "BlockGroupID",
    block_group_population AS "CensusValue",
    "StateCountyTractID",
    tract_population AS "TotalTractPopulation",
    ROUND(block_group_population / NULLIF(tract_population, 0), 4) AS "PopulationRatio"
FROM block_group_data
ORDER BY "StateCountyTractID", "BlockGroupID";
```
</details>

<details>
<summary><b>View SlayQL SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
WITH block_group_population AS (
    -- Get total population (MetricID = 'B01003_001E') for each block group in New York State
    SELECT
        "Fact"."BlockGroupID",
        "Fact"."CensusValue" AS "block_group_population",
        "Geo"."StateCountyTractID"
    FROM "CENSUS_GALAXY__ZIP_CODE_TO_BLOCK_GROUP_SAMPLE"."PUBLIC"."Fact_CensusValues_ACS2021" AS "Fact"
    INNER JOIN "CENSUS_GALAXY__ZIP_CODE_TO_BLOCK_GROUP_SAMPLE"."PUBLIC"."Dim_CensusGeography" AS "Geo"
        ON "Fact"."BlockGroupID" = "Geo"."BlockGroupID"
    WHERE "Fact"."MetricID" = 'B01003_001E'
      AND "Geo"."StateFIPS" = '36'
)
SELECT
    "BlockGroupID",
    "block_group_population" AS "CensusValue",
    "StateCountyTractID",
    SUM("block_group_population") OVER (PARTITION BY "StateCountyTractID") AS "total_tract_population",
    ROUND(
        "block_group_population" / NULLIF(SUM("block_group_population") OVER (PARTITION BY "StateCountyTractID"), 0),
        4
    ) AS "population_ratio"
FROM block_group_population
ORDER BY "StateCountyTractID", "BlockGroupID";
```
</details>

#### 📜 Generated SQL Queries

<details>
<summary><b>View Baseline SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
WITH "NY_Zips" AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "ZipCode"
    FROM "CENSUS_GALAXY__AIML_MODEL_DATA_ENRICHMENT_SAMPLE"."PUBLIC"."LU_GeographyExpanded"
    WHERE "PreferredStateAbbrev" = 'NY'
),
"Zip_Commute_OverHour" AS (
    SELECT
        f."ZipCode",
        SUM(f."CensusValueByZip") AS "TotalCommutersOverHour"
    FROM "CENSUS_GALAXY__AIML_MODEL_DATA_ENRICHMENT_SAMPLE"."PUBLIC"."Fact_CensusValues_ACS2021_ByZip" f
    WHERE f."MetricID" IN ('B08303_011E', 'B08303_012E', 'B08303_013E')
      AND f."ZipCode" IN (SELECT "ZipCode" FROM "NY_Zips")
    GROUP BY f."ZipCode"
),
"State_Benchmark_OverHour" AS (
    SELECT
        SUM("StateBenchmarkValue") AS "StateBenchmarkOverHour"
    FROM "CENSUS_GALAXY__AIML_MODEL_DATA_ENRICHMENT_SAMPLE"."PUBLIC"."Fact_StateBenchmark_ACS2021"
    WHERE "StateAbbrev" = 'NY'
      AND "MetricID" IN ('B08303_011E', 'B08303_012E', 'B08303_013E')
),
"State_Population" AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "TotalStatePopulation"
    FROM "CENSUS_GALAXY__AIML_MODEL_DATA_ENRICHMENT_SAMPLE"."PUBLIC"."Fact_StateBenchmark_ACS2021"
    WHERE "StateAbbrev" = 'NY'
)
SELECT
    z."ZipCode",
    z."TotalCommutersOverHour",
    s."StateBenchmarkOverHour",
    p."TotalStatePopulation"
FROM "Zip_Commute_OverHour" z
CROSS JOIN "State_Benchmark_OverHour" s
CROSS JOIN "State_Population" p
ORDER BY z."TotalCommutersOverHour" DESC
LIMIT 1;
```
</details>

<details>
<summary><b>View SlayQL SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
-- CTE to get the top NY zip code for commuters traveling over one hour (MetricID = 'B08303_011E')
WITH top_zip AS (
    SELECT 
        f."ZipCode", 
        f."CensusValueByZip" AS total_commuters
    FROM 
        CENSUS_GALAXY__AIML_MODEL_DATA_ENRICHMENT_SAMPLE.PUBLIC.Fact_CensusValues_ACS2021_ByZip f
    JOIN 
        CENSUS_GALAXY__AIML_MODEL_DATA_ENRICHMENT_SAMPLE.PUBLIC.LU_GeographyExpanded g
        ON f."ZipCode" = g."ZipCode"
    WHERE 
        g."PreferredStateAbbrev" = 'NY'
        AND f."MetricID" = 'B08303_011E'
    ORDER BY 
        f."CensusValueByZip" DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
-- CTE to extract state‑level values for the same metric and total population
state_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        MAX(CASE WHEN "MetricID" = 'B08303_011E' THEN "StateBenchmarkValue" END) AS state_commuters_over_1hr,
        MAX(CASE WHEN "MetricID" = 'B01003_001E' THEN "TotalStatePopulation" END) AS state_population
    FROM 
        CENSUS_GALAXY__AIML_MODEL_DATA_ENRICHMENT_SAMPLE.PUBLIC.Fact_StateBenchmark_ACS2021
    WHERE 
        "StateAbbrev" = 'NY'
        AND "MetricID" IN ('B08303_011E', 'B01003_001E')
)
-- Final output including zip code, total commuters, state benchmark, and state population
SELECT 
    t."ZipCode",
    t.total_commuters,
    s.state_commuters_over_1hr,
    s.state_population
FROM 
    top_zip t, 
    state_metrics s;
```
</details>
